title: Final potential energy difference
description: Essential: The answer must be expressed as ΔE_p = (1/2) m v_0^2 cos²θ or an equivalent correct form.

title: Force balance condition
description: Important: The solution must state or apply the equilibrium condition mg = Eq tanθ, relating gravity, electric force, and the angle.

title: Work by electric force
description: Important: The solution must correctly calculate the work done by the constant electric force as W = -Eq * (horizontal displacement).

title: Kinematics for stopping distance
description: Important: The solution must use the correct kinematic equation (v_f² = v_0² + 2as) to find the distance 's' along the incline where the ball stops.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the deceleration along the line of motion as a = g/sinθ from the net force component.

title: Relation ΔE_p = -W
description: Optional: The solution may explicitly state the fundamental relationship that the change in electric potential energy is the negative of the work done by the electric field.

title: Sign error in work or ΔE_p
description: Pitfall: A common error is to get the sign wrong in the relationship W = -ΔE_p, leading to an incorrect sign for the final answer.

title: Incorrect force resolution
description: Pitfall: A common error is to incorrectly resolve the forces (gravity and electric) along the direction of motion, leading to a wrong expression for acceleration or force balance.
